_note: Single source of truth for every constant the economics engine uses (ADR-03-001; C13: also the single source for per-mile cost). Any value change MUST bump scoring_config_version and move the previous file to config/history/ so historical scorecards replay under the config that produced them. Leaves are {value, basis, note?, source?}. basis uses Agent 03's short alias (FACT|INFER|REC|UNK), permitted inside 03 blocks by ADR-0004 ruling 7. Owner-policy values carry source=MICHAEL_DECISIONS and are coordinator defaults, NOT Michael-confirmed business truth.
_changelog: 2026.10.3: C-23 (F-57/F-58). current_cash has ONE source: operator_context.current_cash, mirrored from config/operator_profile.v1.json current_cash_context.value (Michael-set; null = UNKNOWN). The per-item economics.context.current_cash is no longer accepted. Added ranking.wrong_buy_season_factor_max: a CAPITAL_INTENSIVE_FLIP whose seasonality_factor is at or below it gets an explicit WRONG BUY TODAY reason line and ranking.timing_flag. No other value changed from 2026.10.2.

2026.10.2: C-19 / ADR-0012 (owner rule, Michael via ARIA-20261007-1840): NO universal absolute-profit floor. Removed capital_and_risk.min_profit_flip (150) and min_profit_service (100), the min_profit_ok gate, the ev_min_profit_ok YES condition and alert_thresholds.ev_multiple_of_min_profit. Replaced by class-aware gates: deal_classes (thresholds mirrored from config/operator_profile.v1.json deal_classes; PROVISIONAL, MICHAEL_DECISIONS #9) and class_gates (per-class data thresholds, the only place an absolute-profit requirement may live), plus a ranking block (risk-adjusted profit x confidence x capital velocity, every component stored). alert_thresholds.ev_cash_multiple_min and service_ev_pph_multiple_of_target re-base the alert rule. All other values unchanged from 2026.10.1.

2026.10.1: engine-ready. Formula strings replaced by numeric parameters (p_waste, confidence haircut). vehicle_cost_per_mile is no longer stored; it is derived (fuel/mpg + wear) so it cannot drift from its parts (C13). Added: service confidence checklist, skill proficiency store, license-gated skill list, time-to-cash defaults, service bad-job recovery, distance-ratio-gate radius, YES evidence requirements (sold comps, scope, title, remote verification), service alert rule, evidence search order. Threshold values unchanged from 2026.10.0. C14 resolved by keeping the YES rule (EV profit/hour >= target) and correcting AT-14; see docs/decisions/ADR-03-002-round-two-engine.md.

vehicle_mpg.note: work truck; item logistics may override per vehicle

wear_per_mile.note: tires + maintenance + depreciation. v = fuel/mpg + wear = 0.4578/mi; IRS all-in ~0.70/mi is a cross-check only

w_min_per_hour.note: absolute floor; deterministic profit/hour below it is a hard PASS. Also prices Michael's travel time in the distance-ratio gate and wasted-trip EV

w_target_flip_per_hour.note: EV profit/hour required for a flip YES

w_target_service_per_hour.note: EV profit/hour required for a service YES

risk_capital_per_deal_cap.note: max cash tied up in one deal; above it is a hard PASS (escalation is Agent 05's budget ledger, not the engine)

max_loss_cap.note: largest single-deal loss tolerated (worst branch with non-zero probability)

f_diag_parts_fraction_on_fail.note: fraction of parts spent before discovering the repair fails

operator_context._note: Mirrored from config/operator_profile.v1.json current_cash_context (the data source of record; a test fails on drift). Michael-stated available cash. null = UNKNOWN: cash-pressure factor 1 and the scorecard says so. Never set per item and never guessed by an agent.

deal_classes._note: Class boundaries, mirrored from config/operator_profile.v1.json deal_classes (the data source of record; tests fail on drift). PROVISIONAL: proposed by Agent 01 from Michael's training examples; he confirms in MICHAEL_DECISIONS #9. cash at risk = cash tied up; days = expected time to cash. Order: CAPITAL_INTENSIVE_FLIP, MICRO_FLIP, QUICK_TURN, else STANDARD_FLIP.

class_gates._note: Per-class DATA thresholds (ADR-0012: an absolute-profit requirement is allowed only here, per class, never universal). min_net_profit = hard gate on deterministic net profit; min_ev_profit and min_cash_multiple = YES conditions on EV after haircut. cash multiple = (cash at risk + EV) / cash at risk. A micro or quick flip needs only a positive EV and a good multiple; a capital-intensive flip must also clear a meaningful absolute profit because it traps cash. PROVISIONAL (MICHAEL_DECISIONS #9).

min_cash_multiple.note: services have little cash at risk; pph_floor_ok and the service $/h target govern

ranking._note: Ranking objective (C-19/C-20): rank_score = risk_adjusted_profit x confidence x capital_velocity x seasonality_factor x cash_pressure_factor; every component is stored separately. risk_adjusted_profit = EV net profit + personal_use_value - risk_aversion x P(loss) x max_loss. capital_velocity = (EV net profit / max(cash at risk, velocity_cash_floor)) / max(days to cash, velocity_min_days), i.e. return per dollar per day. A non-positive risk_adjusted_profit is never rescued by velocity: rank_score = risk_adjusted_profit x confidence. Unknown seasonality / cash context contribute factor 1 and are reported as unknown.

velocity_cash_floor.note: avoids an infinite velocity on a near-zero outlay

velocity_cap_per_day.note: cap on return per dollar per day (100%/day) so a near-free, instant job cannot outrank everything; services, whose binding constraint is hours not cash, should be ranked within their lane

wrong_buy_season_factor_max.note: a capital-intensive flip at or below this seasonality factor (e.g. a mower bought late in the season) is flagged WRONG BUY TODAY

cash_pressure_weight.note: factor = 1 - weight x min(1, cash at risk / current cash) when Michael has stated current cash; 1 when unknown

flip_dom_days_default.note: used only when neither holding.expected_hold_days nor resale.expected_dom_days is supplied

service_hours_per_job_day.note: job_days = ceil(labor_hours / this) when job.job_days absent

revenue_recovered_if_job_goes_bad.note: bad-job branch (rework / dispute / nonpayment): deposit + this fraction of the remaining balance is collected

skill_fit_high_threshold.note: derived evidence item skill_fit_high = skill_fit >= this

beyond_normal_radius_penalty.note: subtracted from confidence beyond distance_rules.normal_radius_miles_one_way (no casual revisit)

require_repair_scope_known_for_yes_flip.note: a guessed fault caps a flip at MAYBE (§15)

ev_cash_multiple_min.note: flip alert: (cash at risk + EV after haircut) / cash at risk must be at least this; replaces ev_multiple_of_min_profit x universal floor

service_ev_pph_multiple_of_target.note: service alert: EV profit/hour must be at least this multiple of the service target

normal_radius_miles_one_way.note: Conway / Central AR; beyond it the confidence penalty applies

distance_ratio_gate_beyond_miles.note: hard gate (§13-1) applies only beyond this; inside it travel is already priced through cash + profit/hour

skills._note: Skill-proficiency store (gap 2). Coverage uses Michael's stated skills (FACT); proficiency levels are REC priors that LEARN updates via a config bump. A required skill not listed here counts as NOT covered.

license_gated_skills.note: Agent 05 owns the authoritative allow-list; a required skill here that is not in licenses_held is a hard PASS

evidence_search._note: Order in which missing evidence is tried when naming cheapest_decisive_evidence (cheapest first). REC.

trim_each_side.note: drop this many lowest and highest sold prices when n >= 5
